bio: Founder @TensorEdgeVN. Ultra-fast C++/CUDA/ARM LLM inference engine for on-prem enterprise & telco deployments in SEA. Previously HPC kernel engineer.
discovered_via: SEG-02: LLM Inference & AI Infra Builders

recent_posts.text: Just open-sourced our AWQ-W4A8 speculative decoding kernel for L40S GPUs (`tensoredge-vn/edge-vllm`). Sustains 142 tok/s/user at batch size 32 on 70B models with <1.5% perplexity drift on Vietnamese & Bahasa legal benchmarks.
Deploying on-prem AI for ASEAN banks and telcos means you rarely get H100 clusters. Squeezing 3x throughput out of existing dual-A10G and L4 racks is where the real adoption unlocks.
